s:hokkaido/odori-park: Elevated view from Sapporo TV Tower looking west along Odori Park in early February during the Snow Festival: a long straight strip of large white snow sculptures and snowy lawns between parallel avenues of city buildings, bare trees, small distant visitors, crisp clear winter afternoon light.
s:hokkaido/otaru-canal: View along Otaru Canal on a winter evening: old grey stone warehouses with dark roofs lining one bank behind a stone promenade with lit gas lamps, snow banks along the dark still water, soft lamp reflections, light snowfall at blue hour.
s:hokkaido/farm-tomita: Wide view across Farm Tomita in mid-July: gently sloping rows of purple lavender in the foreground, then long parallel stripes of red, white, pink and orange flowers running down a hillside, the green Tokachi mountain range in the distance, bright summer sunshine, a few white clouds.
s:hokkaido/shirogane-blue-pond: Eye-level view from the shore path at Shirogane Blue Pond on a clear summer midday: still, milky turquoise-blue water with bare grey dead larch trunks standing upright in it, a few fallen trunks, green birch and larch forest around the edge, mirror-like reflections, bright soft sunlight.
s:hokkaido/asahiyama-zoo: A line of king penguins waddling along a packed-snow path between low snowbanks at Asahiyama Zoo in winter, seen from a low angle, small distant visitors in warm coats behind a rope, snowy evergreens on the hillside, soft overcast light.
s:hokkaido/mount-hakodate: Night view from the summit of Mount Hakodate: the city lights spread across a narrow isthmus pinched between two dark bays, forming a glowing fan shape, an orange and white grid of streets, the dark slopes of the mountain in the foreground, deep blue twilight sky just after sunset.
s:hokkaido/goryokaku: Aerial view from the observation deck of Goryokaku Tower in early May: the five-pointed star-shaped fortress outlined by a moat and earthen ramparts, its edges lined with pink cherry blossom, the white-walled, dark-roofed reconstructed magistrate's office in the centre, city streets around, clear spring sky.
s:hokkaido/noboribetsu-jigokudani: Looking down into Noboribetsu Jigokudani from the wooden walkway: a barren volcanic valley of pale yellow, orange and grey eroded rock with white steam rising from vents and small bubbling pools, a boardwalk winding through it, green forested ridges around, overcast diffuse light.
s:hokkaido/shiretoko-goko: View from the elevated wooden boardwalk at the Shiretoko Five Lakes in early summer: a calm lake framed by dense mixed forest, its still water reflecting the jagged Shiretoko mountain range with lingering patches of snow, green bamboo grass meadow in the foreground, clear blue sky, crisp morning light.
s:hokkaido/jozankei-onsen: The Futami suspension bridge at Jozankei Onsen in mid-October: a red suspension bridge spanning a narrow rocky river gorge, steep slopes covered in red, orange and yellow autumn foliage, emerald green water below, light mist, soft overcast light.
f:hokkaido/jingisukan: A dome-shaped cast-iron Jingisukan grill on a tabletop burner, slices of lamb sizzling on the raised centre while bean sprouts, onion and cabbage cook in the rim below, a small bowl of dipping sauce beside, 45-degree angle, warm restaurant light, light smoke, shallow depth of field.
f:hokkaido/soup-curry: A wide shallow bowl of Sapporo soup curry seen from 45 degrees: thin reddish-brown curry broth with a whole bone-in chicken leg, large chunks of grilled pumpkin, eggplant, green pepper, okra and a half-boiled egg, a separate plate of rice with a lemon wedge, wooden table, natural window light, shallow depth of field.
f:hokkaido/kaisendon: Overhead view of a Hokkaido kaisendon in a lacquered bowl: rice topped with glossy orange salmon roe, golden sea urchin, pink crab meat, white scallops and slices of tuna, a shiso leaf and wasabi on the side, miso soup and a soy sauce dish beside, market counter, natural light.
f:hokkaido/miso-ramen: A deep bowl of Sapporo miso ramen at 45 degrees: opaque golden-brown miso broth with a sheen of oil, thick wavy yellow noodles, a mound of stir-fried bean sprouts, minced pork, sliced green onion, sweetcorn and a pat of butter on top, wooden counter, steam rising, warm light, shallow depth of field.
f:hokkaido/soft-serve: Close-up from slightly below of a tall swirl of white Hokkaido milk soft-serve in a crisp wafer cone, held up by a hand against a softly blurred background of purple lavender fields and green hills, bright summer daylight, shallow depth of field.
